minus_idioms.source: This lexicon lists no Lithuanian idiom that puts "minus" before a positive number.

article_one.source: Lithuanian has no article; "vienas" is a numeral.

of.source: Lithuanian marks the counted noun by case, with no "of" word.

fraction_of.source: Lithuanian marks the counted noun by case, with no "of" word.

denominator_particle.source: Lithuanian has no particle like Portuguese "avos".

class_noun.source: Lithuanian names no digit class with a singular noun after a collective.

half_unit.source: This lexicon lists no unit that a half before it halves.

abbreviation.source: This lexicon lists no number word that a period makes an abbreviation.
